chapter_title_en: A Final Letter and a Flesh-Skin Oath
chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 112: Despair gives way to a strange, living hope
chapter_meta_description: Preparing for a final sacrifice, Li Huowang receives an unexpected path from a reclusive nun: a flesh-skin letter to the mysterious Ao-Jing Sect. A new, uncertain dawn over a wasteland of rats.
og_title: The Rat-Mountain Oath: Hope from an Old Nun’s Skin
og_description: Li Huowang stands at the threshold of death, only to be handed a letter written on living flesh, pointing him toward the strangest cult in the Dao-Twisted World.
twitter_title: A flesh-skin safe-conduct into the unknown…
twitter_description: Desperate, bleeding, and ready to die, Li Huowang gets one final, horrifying chance: the Ao-Jing Sect. But what will they demand?
